description.text: Main Courses Covers preclinical medicine, clinical medicine and public health. Also covers biology, chemistry, immune system, pharmacy.

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Nanchang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo takenHigh School Graduate. HSK 6, or at least one year's Chinese language training from our university. recently of the applicant. 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of High school 5.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test)

requirements.text: High school graduate or above or equivalent. Applicants are required to pass HSK level 3 or above, or at least one year's Chinese language training from our university.
